title: The Administration Element on a Car Rental Damage Recharge
content:
The administration element added to a damage recharge turns on the damage assessments and reviews standing
against the rental, and the charge itself is the one published by the rate class booked among the
Car Rental Rate Classes.

1. Where more than one damage assessment stands approved against the rental, the rate class's damage
   administration charge is added once for each approved assessment.
2. Where the damage was decided within 8 days of the vehicle coming back and a review already stands
   declined against the rental, the rate class's damage administration charge is added at a multiple
   of 1.5.
3. Where neither of those holds of a rental, nothing under this head changes what is added for
   administration.

The damage administration charge is the figure published by the rate class booked.

## Order in which the cases are taken

The rows are taken in the order they stand. A rental carrying three approved assessments and a declined
review is answered by the first row, and the charge is added three times over.

The second row requires both marks together: the decision must have come within 8 calendar days of the
vehicle coming back, and a review must already stand declined against that rental. A rental with a declined
review whose damage was decided 11 days after the vehicle came back reaches neither row.

## Two rentals worked through

A rental on a class whose damage administration charge is 110 USD, carrying two approved damage
assessments: 220 USD is added. The same class with one approved assessment, the damage decided 5 days after
the vehicle came back and one review already standing declined: 165 USD is added.
